title: H-REPORTLOSS-1 leg 1 - a failed bug-report upload is RETRIED instead of lost. The host files one report while the client is connected; the local report stub answers 503 twice, then 200. Asserts: attempt 1 FAILS immediately, attempt 2 FAILS about a minute later with a smaller bundle (no saves), attempt 3 SUCCEEDS about five minutes after attempt 1, and nothing is pending afterwards. Also asserts the save attach: exactly one .hsg for each of the 2 connected players, and the first bundle holds both plus the reporter's Player.log.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1). OPERATOR SETUP OUTSIDE THE RUN (the driver cannot do it): tools/report_stub.py running on a port NOT used by any earlier run, mode `fail 2`; all three BigAmbitionsMP.cfg.*.json files carry "BugReportRelayUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:<that port>/" (restore the previous value after the run). A fresh port matters: a pending report left by an earlier run is abandoned at launch ('upload address changed') instead of spending the stub's two failures. Dev build with the bugreport + bugbudget levers (BAMP_DEV). The CLIENT is dropped right after attempt 1 on purpose: both instances share the bug-reports folder and both run the outbox retry, so with the client gone every retry line lands in the host's log.
oracles_absent: \[BugReport\] (upload task|outbox pass|outbox launch pass|save store attach|save attach players|zip bundle failed|zip rebuild failed|bundle plan failed|report prune|prune ')

steps.note: PREMISE: the default 9 MiB budget is in force and NO report is pending before ours - so the stub's two 503s can only be spent on this run's report

expect_log.regex: \[BugReport\] Upload bundle: bamp-bug-${rid}\.zip \([0-9]+ KB\), attempt 1: .*hsg in=2 out=0, reporter Player\.log included
\[BugReport\] upload attempt 1/6 bamp-bug-${rid} bytes=[0-9]+ timeout=[0-9]+s -> FAIL 503 .*next=20[0-9-]+

steps.note: Attempt 1 runs right away (after the peer-log wait) and the stub answers 503 (its first failure). Premises asserted here: the client IS connected (1 peer asked for logs) and exactly one save per connected player was attached (2 .hsg for 2 players) and all of it fit the default budget alongside the reporter's Player.log.
the client leaves so only the HOST's outbox pass retries - the two rig instances share the bug-reports folder

steps.cmd: mark TEST REPORTLOSS waiting for retry 2

expect_log.regex: \[BugReport\] Upload bundle: bamp-bug-${rid}\.zip \([0-9]+ KB\), attempt 2: .*hsg in=0 out=2, reporter Player\.log included
\[BugReport\] upload attempt 2/6 bamp-bug-${rid} bytes=[0-9]+ timeout=[0-9]+s -> FAIL 503 .*next=20[0-9-]+

steps.note: retry 1 is due 1 minute after attempt 1 and runs on the next ~30 s heartbeat; it rebuilds the zip WITHOUT saves and the stub fails it (its second failure)

steps.cmd: mark TEST REPORTLOSS waiting for retry 3

expect_log.regex: \[BugReport\] Upload bundle: bamp-bug-${rid}\.zip \([0-9]+ KB\), attempt 3: .*hsg in=0 out=2, reporter Player\.log included
\[BugReport\] upload attempt 3/6 bamp-bug-${rid} bytes=[0-9]+ timeout=[0-9]+s -> OK 200 in [0-9]+ms; next=none: sent

steps.note: retry 2 is due 5 minutes after attempt 1 (4 after attempt 2); the stub now answers 200 - the report is delivered
nothing is left pending: the delivered report is marked sent
